#
# Operating this repository:
# - Work happens on verb-prefixed branches, one verb per state (these are branch names, not directories):
# - think/ — explore and decide.
# - plan/ — write the plan as a graph.
# - execute/ — do the work.
# - reflect/ — review after the fact.
# - deploy/ — place the result where it is recorded.
# - Authoring loop: write a vertex, `bedrock check`, `bedrock build`, commit source AND generated output, open a PR — a human merges.
# - The chain: every plan is a promise; its criteria are its oracle; its witnesses prove it held; its residual declares what was not assured.
# - Decisions are records too: why a design is what it is lives in record/ Decision vertices — walk `supersedes` chains before relitigating a choice; write one when you close a fork. Semantics: situation/references/bedrock-operating.md

		bedrock:statement "Chose to represent architecture decisions as Decision vertices in record/, with a supersedes edge forming the append-only chain floor invariant 15 legislates. Rejected: markdown ADR directories (a second truth outside the graph — strands edges, forces full-document reads, the antithesis of progressive disclosure); a stored status field (liveness is derivable from the supersession chain; stored status would drift from it); separate decision/decision-record vertex pairs (the record is the decision's only durable form — two vertices double ceremony for zero assurance). Revisit if decision volume makes the record/ graph noisy to walk, or if consumers need register-level visibility of live decisions.\n" ;
		bedrock:timestamp "2026-08-23T11:09:05" .
	bedrock:vertex\/decision-vertex-face-body a bedrock:ontology\/Decision ;
		bedrock:document bedrock:path\/situation\/record\/decision-vertex-face-body.yamlld ;
		bedrock:label "Vertices are one file: compiled face + uncompiled body" ;
		bedrock:references bedrock:vertex\/invariant-01-possibility-space , bedrock:vertex\/invariant-16-agents-md-register ;
		bedrock:statement "Chose the single-file vertex anatomy (0.5.0): the face — everything but `body` — compiles into the graph; `body`, a literal block scalar of unbounded depth prose, never compiles and is what the automatic `document` edge delivers. Face size is a SOFT budget (4096 chars ≈ 1k tokens, target 500–1000), reported by check/build, never a violation. Consumer CI installs bedrock always-latest from source and dry-runs check + report on every situation PR; the artifact is committed in the PR itself. Rejected: two-file depth (vertex + references/ doc) as the only depth channel — the document edge stays circular and one concept splits across two files; a hard face cap — brittle where guidance suffices; merge-time bot builds of AGENTS.md — a second writer to main and a stale-graph window. Revisit if soft warnings prove ignored at scale (escalate to a repo-configurable artifact byte ceiling), or if bodies grow shared enough that references/ and body duplicate each other.\n" ;
		bedrock:timestamp "2026-08-23T17:30:00" .

graph:definition {
	bedrock:vertex\/invariant-01-possibility-space a bedrock:ontology\/Invariant ;
		bedrock:document bedrock:path\/situation\/definition\/invariant-01-possibility-space.yamlld ;
		bedrock:label "Code is a possibility space" ;
		bedrock:layer "floor" ;
		bedrock:statement "Code is a possibility space. A surface does everything it *can* do, not what its author meant. Work is collapsing possibilities to defined behavior. A green test proves a behavior exists — never that nothing else happens. Say what else could happen; declare what you did not collapse.\n" .
	bedrock:vertex\/invariant-02-gap-suspects a bedrock:ontology\/Invariant ;
		bedrock:document bedrock:path\/situation\/definition\/invariant-02-gap-suspects.yamlld ;
		bedrock:label "A gap has three suspects" ;
		bedrock:layer "floor" ;
		bedrock:statement "A gap has three suspects — the code, the requirement, or the instrument. Interrogate in the open before displacing any of them.\n" .
	bedrock:vertex\/invariant-03-situate-before-acting a bedrock:ontology\/Invariant ;
		bedrock:document bedrock:path\/situation\/definition\/invariant-03-situate-before-acting.yamlld ;
		bedrock:label "Situate before acting; re-situate after" ;
		bedrock:layer "floor" ;
		bedrock:statement "Situate before acting; re-situate after. Relationships carry unequal mass; the loudest, freshest signal is usually the smallest. Interrogate a contradiction before displacing what it contradicts. Authority attaches to landed sentences, not to your readings of them.\n" .
	bedrock:vertex\/invariant-04-completion-boundary a bedrock:ontology\/Invariant ;
		bedrock:document bedrock:path\/situation\/definition\/invariant-04-completion-boundary.yamlld ;
		bedrock:label "Completion is behavior at the promised boundary" ;
		bedrock:layer "floor" ;
		bedrock:statement "Completion is behavior at the promised boundary. Nothing in a deliverable is a stub, placeholder, or deferred branch. Not done: \"compiles\", \"structure in place\", \"foundation for later.\"\n" .
	bedrock:vertex\/invariant-05-make-it-first a bedrock:ontology\/Invariant ;
		bedrock:document bedrock:path\/situation\/definition\/invariant-05-make-it-first.yamlld ;
		bedrock:label "Make it first, prove it after" ;
		bedrock:layer "floor" ;
		bedrock:references bedrock:vertex\/breadcrumb-adversarial-review ;
		bedrock:statement "Make it first, prove it after. Build the slice, prove it, fix, continue. Teardown on demand, never a precondition. Deep adversarial review is human-invoked.\n" .
	bedrock:vertex\/invariant-06-regenerate-from-source a bedrock:ontology\/Invariant ;
		bedrock:document bedrock:path\/situation\/definition\/invariant-06-regenerate-from-source.yamlld ;
		bedrock:label "Verify by regenerating from source" ;
		bedrock:layer "floor" ;
		bedrock:statement "Verify by regenerating from source, never by reading the claim. Gate claims cite a CI run URL, never a local attestation.\n" .
	bedrock:vertex\/invariant-07-predeclare-criteria a bedrock:ontology\/Invariant ;
		bedrock:document bedrock:path\/situation\/definition\/invariant-07-predeclare-criteria.yamlld ;
		bedrock:label "Predeclare criteria" ;
		bedrock:layer "floor" ;
		bedrock:statement "Predeclare criteria before the run that answers them; judge results only against them. A refuted hypothesis is a successful experiment. Mixed outcomes stay mixed — never round toward a verdict. Timebox exploration; when the decision point arrives, resolve with what you have.\n" .
	bedrock:vertex\/invariant-08-dependency-boundary a bedrock:ontology\/Invariant ;
		bedrock:document bedrock:path\/situation\/definition\/invariant-08-dependency-boundary.yamlld ;
		bedrock:label "The dependency boundary is the assurance boundary" ;
		bedrock:layer "floor" ;
		bedrock:statement "The dependency boundary is the assurance boundary. What crosses it version-pinned is assured-by-default at that pin; you verify your *consumption*, never the dependency's internals — the same law root already held for adopted protocols (S3, Matrix, Git), generalized to every crate boundary. Pins are assured versions; bumps are deliberate acts. A missing capability at a consumed boundary is BLOCKING — stop and escalate; working around a boundary is the disqualifying failure.\n" .
	bedrock:vertex\/invariant-09-public-first a bedrock:ontology\/Invariant ;
		bedrock:document bedrock:path\/situation\/definition\/invariant-09-public-first.yamlld ;
		bedrock:label "Public-first" ;
		bedrock:layer "floor" ;
		bedrock:statement "Public-first. Before building inside, ask why this cannot be a public crate or repo; work backwards from that. Extract when the rubric passes; private only for named domain knowledge or secrets.\n" .
	bedrock:vertex\/invariant-10-git-rules a bedrock:ontology\/Invariant ;
		bedrock:document bedrock:path\/situation\/definition\/invariant-10-git-rules.yamlld ;
		bedrock:label "Git: force push does not exist" ;
		bedrock:layer "floor" ;
		bedrock:statement "Git: force push does not exist; nothing pushed is deleted; one writer per ref; PRs always — a human merges the default branch. Same policy in every repo.\n" .
	bedrock:vertex\/invariant-11-ci-rules a bedrock:ontology\/Invariant ;
		bedrock:document bedrock:path\/situation\/definition\/invariant-11-ci-rules.yamlld ;
		bedrock:label "CI: one runner posture, the real suite" ;
		bedrock:layer "floor" ;
		bedrock:statement "CI: every Linux/platform-neutral job runs on `org-ci-linux-x64`; WarpBuild only for native macOS/Windows artifacts (`warp-macos-15-arm64-6x`, `warp-windows-latest-x64-4x`); fork-PR code is mechanically rejected before runner assignment; a missing host tool is a P0 infrastructure defect — never install a hidden substitute; CI runs the real suite (fmt, clippy `-D warnings`, locked build, nextest).\n" .
	bedrock:vertex\/invariant-12-toolchain a bedrock:ontology\/Invariant ;
		bedrock:document bedrock:path\/situation\/definition\/invariant-12-toolchain.yamlld ;
		bedrock:label "One fixed toolchain per repo" ;
		bedrock:layer "floor" ;
		bedrock:statement "One fixed toolchain per repo, canonical task names; never invent a second one.\n" .
	bedrock:vertex\/invariant-13-state a bedrock:ontology\/Invariant ;
		bedrock:document bedrock:path\/situation\/definition\/invariant-13-state.yamlld ;
		bedrock:label "State: one storage truth through the kernel" ;
		bedrock:layer "floor" ;
		bedrock:statement "State: one storage truth through the kernel; records are immutable, created by conditional write; pointers move by CAS; every projection is rebuildable from records; reads are fenced; an integrity failure is never translated to absence.\n" .
	bedrock:vertex\/invariant-14-tailscale-first a bedrock:ontology\/Invariant ;
		bedrock:document bedrock:path\/situation\/definition\/invariant-14-tailscale-first.yamlld ;
		bedrock:label "Tailscale-first" ;
		bedrock:layer "floor" ;
		bedrock:statement "Tailscale-first: all internal reach rides the tailnet; SSH-over-Tailscale for operators; nothing internal is served outside it; public-IP access is break-glass only.\n" .
	bedrock:vertex\/invariant-15-decisions-append-only a bedrock:ontology\/Invariant ;
		bedrock:document bedrock:path\/situation\/definition\/invariant-15-decisions-append-only.yamlld ;
		bedrock:label "Decisions are append-only" ;
		bedrock:layer "floor" ;
		bedrock:statement "Decisions are append-only: ADRs are immutable — supersede, never edit.\n" .
	bedrock:vertex\/invariant-16-agents-md-register a bedrock:ontology\/Invariant ;
		bedrock:document bedrock:path\/situation\/definition\/invariant-16-agents-md-register.yamlld ;
		bedrock:label "AGENTS.md is the compiled graph" ;
		bedrock:layer "floor" ;
		bedrock:statement "AGENTS.md is the compiled graph: one artifact — the complete TriG compiled from `situation/`, injected into every agent context by the harness. Never hand-edited; always regenerated. Each node carries its description, its relationships, and a pointer to its own source document; humans read prose in `situation/`. After work that changes reality, re-situate it — emit knowledge, never rules.\n" .
}

graph:definition {
	bedrock:vertex\/term-promise-witness-oracle a bedrock:ontology\/Term ;
		bedrock:document bedrock:path\/situation\/definition\/term-promise-witness-oracle.yamlld ;
		bedrock:label "promise, oracle, witness, residual" ;
		bedrock:layer "floor" ;
		bedrock:statement "A promise states behavior; an oracle judges promise against actual. A witness is the retained observation of one run and proves existence, never exclusivity. Residual is what was deliberately not assured, declared so everyone sees the line of demarcation — we assure the positive space only; the negative space is infinite.\n" .
}
